success.label: REFERENCE POSITIVE: adapter seated in the socket, with the released gripper hovering above it.
REFERENCE NEGATIVE: gripper still gripping/pressing the adapter at the socket.

drop.label: REFERENCE location=TABLE: adapter on the table in front of the power strip, with no support from stand or socket.
REFERENCE location=SOCKET: adapter seated in the rightmost socket after release; the white block on the left is the empty stand.
